answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 41 aliases, and each one needs its own funded zephyr account. Deposits are visible in opal, and nadir reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 43% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 3202 identities would post 2464 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
